name: Isabella
source:
Isabella is a high-school student that is part of the same gymnastics team as Mila, Polly, and Sophia.

She is also a dance student at Svetlana's dance studio and she is first encountered when Svetlana calls her in to be the protagonist's partner so she can observe his form from afar. Isabella tells him that she has danced since she was eight.

She is quite shy with new people but Svetlana says that she is bubbly and energetic once she gets to know them.

Isabella mentions that her mom died giving birth to her and her father left her at the church when she was two. She now lives in the women's shelter behind the church. She says that Sister Maria was like her big sister when she grew up.
